requires: GLB 2.0 with embedded textures and skin
idle/run/attack/cast/hurt/death bound to actual distinct animation clips
normalized skin weights and valid joint indices
GGD vfx definitions and event scripts
resolved animation pulses, anchors and VFX references

excluded_from_standardized_catalog: placeholder movement or hurt mapped to idle
note: Standardization is a reusable resource format check. It is not production publication, game balancing, complete visual fidelity, or GGD multiplayer acceptance. A standalone VFX library is not a complete character package.
